text: Map and filter are two classic tools for transforming lists without writing a single loop.
Map applies a function to every item in a sequence — here we double each number in one clean line.
Notice map returns a special map object, so we wrap it in list to actually see the results.
[chuckle] Filter is its partner — it keeps only the items where the function returns true.
So filtering for the even numbers leaves us with two, four, and six.
[sigh] Map isn't limited to lambdas — you can hand it any named function, like this Celsius to Fahrenheit converter.
Each temperature flows through the function and comes out converted.
And the real elegance is chaining them — first filter to keep the evens, then map to square each one.
[groan] Two tiny functions, no loops, and the whole transformation reads almost like a sentence.
